evidence.quote: I built a booking form for our community workshop using JavaScript and a small web server.
I first drew the screens with the volunteers, then made a working prototype they could try on their phones.
We changed the form after watching where people got stuck.
I fixed the check and wrote test cases for repeated requests and missing fields.
I wrote a practical guide for the volunteers who maintain the booking tool.
I built a spreadsheet that logged everything we threw away, by day and by reason.
I compared the totals each week and found that most waste came from sandwiches prepared after lunch.
I organised stock checks and showed six new colleagues how to update the ordering sheet.
I organised stock checks and showed six new colleagues how to update the ordering sheet.
evidence.mark: showed six new colleagues how to update the ordering sheet

evidence.quote: I collected brake and battery measurements in a bicycle repair workshop.
I compared the results from repeated battery tests and plotted the readings by temperature.
evidence.mark: compared the results from repeated battery tests and plotted the readings by temperature

evidence.quote: I wrote down the measurement setup with a diagram, the tool settings and the order of the checks.
evidence.mark: wrote down the measurement setup with a diagram

evidence.quote: I kept the stock records at an equipment rental desk.
I built a spreadsheet listing each item, its return date and its condition, then checked it against the shelf every Friday.
I handled customer questions when a rented tool stopped working.
I taught two new colleagues how to check returns and update the stock sheet.
I mapped how a repair request moved between the reception desk and the volunteer fixing it.
evidence.mark: mapped how a repair request moved

evidence.quote: I taught new volunteers how to record a repair and find the safety instructions.
I monitored a community media server during live broadcasts.
Former volunteers still had access, so I checked the list with the studio manager and removed accounts after approval.
I wrote a runbook for the person on duty when the media server stopped responding.
I wrote automated browser tests for a sports club membership service.
I collected the results from several test runs and grouped failures by screen and browser.
evidence.mark: grouped failures by screen and browser

evidence.quote: I combined monthly order files into a PostgreSQL database for a small distributor.
The files used different customer codes, so I made a mapping table and checked duplicates before importing anything.
evidence.mark: made a mapping table and checked duplicates before importing anything

evidence.quote: I wrote SQL queries to compare the old totals with the new database.
I grouped the differences by product and reason, checked a sample with the packing team and found that damaged items were recorded twice.
evidence.mark: grouped the differences by product and reason

evidence.quote: I drew a data model showing customers, orders and returns and explained it to the finance team.
I wrote the import checks next to the diagram, including how to handle a missing identifier.
evidence.mark: wrote the import checks next to the diagram
